d:
"Sheher Se Durr" by Naam Sujal captures the journey of an individual distancing themselves from the city to chase dreams, grappling with self-doubt, family sacrifices, and societal expectations. It highlights their struggles, guilt, and gratitude towards loved ones, especially their hardworking father and supportive mother. The song balances themes of ambition, emotional conflict, and the desire for belonging, ending on a hopeful note of resilience and togetherness.
Song Credits
Track Name: Sheher Se Durr
Written & Performed By: Naam Sujal
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
